$comment: Tip-jar products for Google Play. Product ids are fixed in the app (services/tip-jar.ts, TipJarPlugin.java); names, descriptions and prices are store data and may be changed here or in the Play Console at any time. `price` is the consumer price in EUR for Germany; `defaultVatRate` is only used to derive the tax-exclusive base that Google's price converter expects. The package name comes from src/web/capacitor.config.ts. Apply with `node src/store/play-products.mjs --apply`.
